name: JSON Formatter & Validator
shortDescription: Beautify, validate, format, and minify JSON strings with error checking.
privacyNotice: 100% Client-Side. Your JSON payloads, keys, and values never leave your browser.

howToUse.text: Paste your raw, minified, or unformatted JSON text into the editor.
Click 'Format 2 Spaces', 'Format 4 Spaces', or 'Minify' based on your requirement.
Inspect syntax errors on the alert banner if invalid, or copy the formatted JSON with one click.

features: Instant syntax validation with descriptive error locations
High-speed minification for API payload reduction
Payload byte size counter and line numbering
Sample JSON template for quick testing
Strict client-side execution keeping API keys and secrets private
limitations: Validates standard RFC 8259 JSON specifications (trailing commas and unquoted keys are highlighted as errors)
Extremely large payloads (>50MB) may hit browser memory thresholds

faqs.q: Is it safe to format JSON containing production API keys?
faqs.a: Yes. ToolXDev executes all JSON formatting locally in your browser sandbox. No data is sent over the network.

faqs.q: Why does JSON validation fail on my input?
faqs.a: Common issues include unescaped quotes, trailing commas in objects or arrays, or missing quotation marks around property names.
